# Perplexity API changelog — captured 2026-08-21
# https://docs.perplexity.ai/changelog   Tier: watching

## August 2026 — new models only. NOTHING above the watching-tier bar.
New models on the Agent and/or Router APIs:
- `google/gemini-3.7-flash`                    ($0.375 / $0.0375 cached / $1.875 per M tokens)
- `xai/grok-4.6`                               (Agent API; xAI flagship reasoning/agentic model)
- `perplexity/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b`      ($0.25 in|cached / $2.50 out per M)
- `perplexity/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b`  (open-weight reasoning, tiered pricing)
- `perplexity/deepseek-v4-flash-0731`          (1M-token context)

Agent API: the **fast preset** now uses `openai/gpt-5.6-luna` with minimal reasoning and priority
processing, applied automatically to dynamic requests.

No new APIs, agent capabilities, connectors or MCP features. Model additions on an existing API
surface remain below the reporting bar for a watching-tier platform (consistent with 2026-08-14,
which held four new Agent API models).

Updated: 2026-08-21 — no finding.
